We need clear owners for: backfill (token counts), invoice corrections, and telemetry/runbook fixes. Reply with owner + ETA.

Ill take the backfill + final token deltas. Need raw logs + tokenizer map. Dry-run today, final CSV by tomorrow EOD.

I will own invoice corrections and credit memos. Blocked until Ashwin posts deltas; need numbers by Tue 17:00 PT.

Ill own alerts and runbook. Adding ingestion-lag alert (>10m) and a pre-apply sanity check. PR by Tue COB.

Leo (Platform): Ack
Short-term mitigation: pin metering-api min replicas to 3 and add backpressure. Opening infra PR today. Observed autoscaler flip at 2025-11-12T02:14Z.

LedgerBot: Ticket FI-7001 created: "Billing: token ingest backfill + invoice corrections" assigned to Maya (Billing).

Action summary Ill add to postmortem: Ashwin=backfill (Wed EOD), Sam=alerts/runbook (Tue), Leo=infra PR (Mon), Maya=invoices/comms (Tue COB). Ill update execs once final numbers confirmed.
